name: c-time-picker-9
title: Time zone label
description: Event time in the venue's time zone, shown in the trigger, with a footer that leaves out Now.

files.content:
import { TimePicker, TimePickerClear, TimePickerColumns, TimePickerConfirm, TimePickerContent, TimePickerFooter, TimePickerTrigger, TimePickerValue, } from "@/components/reui/time-picker" import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldLabel, } from "@/components/ui/field" import { IconPlaceholder } from "@/app/(create)/components/icon-placeholder" export function Pattern() { return (
Doors open {/* The zone is a fixed label, not a conversion: the value is the venue's wall-clock time. The label and the value name the trigger, so the zone joins them as its description. */} Berlin time {/* Children replace the default value and clock, so the clock is added back; `data-icon` keeps the button's end padding. */} {/* No Now: it would read the viewer's clock, not the venue's. */} Shown on every ticket in venue time, wherever the buyer is.
) }
